defs.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
defs.genInstructions: Build a vertical sidebar listing home zones (Living Room, Kitchen, Bedroom, Office, Garage, Outdoor) with icons, per-room active-device counts, temperature badge, and an 'All Rooms' entry; selecting a room becomes the global scope filter for the rest of the panel.
defs.role: The primary navigation scope for the panel, selecting which room's devices, climate, and activity the rest of the UI displays.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scene Launcher Strip
effectors.description: When a scene is activated, the sidebar receives the updated per-room active-device counts and temperature badges and re-renders them to reflect the new device states.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
effectors.description: When a device is toggled on/off in the grid, it emits a room id and delta so the sidebar increments/decrements that room's active-device count badge.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: On room selection, emits the selected room id (or 'all'); the grid re-queries and renders only device tiles belonging to that room, resetting scroll and its category filter to 'All'.

targets.name: Smart Home: Climate Control Dial
targets.description: On room selection, emits the room id; the dial loads and displays that room's thermostat target/current temperature, humidity and mode, and subsequent adjustments apply to that room's thermostat.

targets.name: Smart Home: Activity & Automation Feed
targets.description: On room selection, emits the room id; the feed filters its event list to events originating from devices in that room ('all' shows the whole home).

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
targets.description: On room selection, emits the room id; the monitor scopes its consumption charts and per-device breakdown to that room, or shows whole-home totals for 'all'.

defs.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
defs.genInstructions: Build a responsive grid of device tiles (lights, plugs, locks, blinds, speakers, fans) each with icon, name, state label, quick toggle and an inline control (brightness/level slider) plus a category filter row and a tile detail expansion.
defs.role: The main workspace where the user directly views and controls every device in the selected room.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected room id and renders only that room's device tiles, resetting category filter to 'All'.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scene Launcher Strip
effectors.description: On scene activation, receives the batch of device state changes (on/off, brightness, color) and animates the affected tiles to their new states.

targets.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
targets.description: Emits room id and +/-1 whenever a device is switched on or off so the sidebar's active-device count badge updates live.

targets.name: Smart Home: Activity & Automation Feed
targets.description: Every device interaction emits an event {device name, room, action, value, timestamp, source:'manual'} which the feed prepends as a new entry.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
targets.description: Toggling a device or changing its level emits its updated estimated wattage so the monitor recomputes current draw and updates the live total and per-device bars.

defs.name: Smart Home: Climate Control Dial
defs.genInstructions: Build a circular thermostat dial for the selected room with drag-to-set target temperature, current temp and humidity readout, heat/cool/auto/off mode buttons, fan speed selector and a compact 24h temperature trend sparkline.
defs.role: The dedicated climate console for the selected room, complementing the device grid with fine-grained thermostat control.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected room id and loads that room's thermostat target, current temperature, humidity, mode and trend history.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scene Launcher Strip
effectors.description: Scene activation pushes a target temperature and HVAC mode for the active room; the dial animates to the new setpoint and updates mode buttons.

targets.name: Smart Home: Activity & Automation Feed
targets.description: Setpoint, mode or fan changes emit an event {room, 'Thermostat set to X°', timestamp, source:'manual'} that the feed prepends.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
targets.description: Changing setpoint or HVAC mode emits the new expected HVAC load so the monitor updates the HVAC segment of the consumption chart and the live draw total.

defs.name: Smart Home: Scene Launcher Strip
defs.genInstructions: Build a horizontal strip of scene cards (Good Morning, Away, Movie Night, Bedtime, Party) with icons, affected-device counts, one-tap activation with active-state highlight, plus create/edit scene controls.
defs.role: The one-tap macro layer that applies coordinated device and climate presets across the home, driving the grid, dial, sidebar and feed.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: Activating a scene emits its full device state payload (per-device on/off, brightness, color); the grid applies and animates each affected tile.

targets.name: Smart Home: Climate Control Dial
targets.description: Activating a scene emits target temperature and HVAC mode; the dial animates to the new setpoint and mode.

targets.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
targets.description: After a scene applies, emits recalculated per-room active-device counts and temperatures so the sidebar badges refresh.

targets.name: Smart Home: Activity & Automation Feed
targets.description: Scene activation emits an event {scene name, device count, timestamp, source:'scene'} that the feed prepends as a highlighted entry.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
targets.description: Scene activation emits the aggregate wattage delta of all changed devices so the monitor updates its live draw figure and chart.

defs.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
defs.genInstructions: Build an energy panel with a live current-draw figure, a stacked consumption chart over selectable ranges (day/week/month), a ranked per-device/per-category breakdown with bars, and cost estimate.
defs.role: The analytics surface that reports the power and cost consequences of the device, climate and scene states controlled elsewhere.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected room id and scopes its charts and breakdown to that room, or whole-home totals for 'all'.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
effectors.description: Receives wattage deltas when devices are toggled or dimmed and updates the live draw total and per-device bars.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Climate Control Dial
effectors.description: Receives HVAC load changes from setpoint/mode edits and updates the HVAC segment and live total.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scene Launcher Strip
effectors.description: Receives the aggregate wattage delta of a scene activation and updates the live draw and chart.

defs.name: Smart Home: Security & Activity Feed
defs.genInstructions: Build a right-hand panel combining home security status (arm/disarm toggle, door/window sensor list, camera thumbnail) with a chronological, filterable activity and automation event log.
defs.role: The awareness panel that arms the home and records every manual, scene, and automated event happening across the other components.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected room id and filters the event log to events from devices in that room; 'all' shows whole-home history.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
effectors.description: Receives manual device-interaction events and prepends them to the log with device name, action, value and timestamp.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Climate Control Dial
effectors.description: Receives thermostat setpoint/mode change events and prepends them to the log.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scene Launcher Strip
effectors.description: Receives scene activation events and prepends them as highlighted log entries showing scene name and affected device count.
